pages.title: 原页对照学习
pages.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a single exceptionally polished high-fidelity desktop web application UI screen for the original Chinese textbook learning product “循证一课 / LEARN & TEACH”. This is a conceptual UI proposal for a new “原页对照学习” screen, not a real uploaded book or production screenshot. Flat front-facing interface, no perspective, no device frame, no outer presentation board. Landscape ratio about 16:10, very crisp high resolution, perfectly aligned Chinese typography.
Match the already approved product visual system: warm ivory paper #FAF9F5, deep forest green #183E32, subtle sage #A4B79A, thin warm gray hairline rules, restrained 5–8px corners, beautiful heavy Chinese Song-style serif headings with very readable sans-serif navigation. Calm university-press editorial feel, no gradients, no purple, no glossy 3D, no generic chat dashboard.
Exact layout: far left 60px deep-forest vertical rail with original eight-point compass mark at top, seven consistent fine-line SVG-style icon buttons with small Chinese labels “首页 / 教材 / 备课 / 研读 / 笔记 / 收藏 / 设置”; “教材” selected in ivory. Topbar 54px contains “循证一课 / LEARN & TEACH”, subtle breadcrumb “概率论基础 > 第二章 条件概率”, bookmark, note and a clean ellipsis utility at far right. No AI connected badge, no verbose technical explanations.
Next 205px is a pale ivory chapter sidebar: small original typographic book cover “概率论基础”, “共4章”; four REAL chapter rows “第一章 事件与概率 / 第二章 条件概率 / 第三章 随机变量 / 第四章 数字特征”; second chapter expanded with two indented knowledge points “条件概率的定义” and active “贝叶斯公式”. Chapters remain the learning units, never page-number batches.
Main area: top compact title bar “原页对照学习”, with view tabs “原文对照 / 讲解 / 练习”. Below, two balanced substantial columns split 51/49 with a subtle vertical draggable separator and small grip. The panes should dominate the available width and height; avoid a tiny centered reading column surrounded by a huge empty space.
LEFT PANE: small pane heading “教材原页”, slim controls “第42页 / 96页”, previous/next small arrows, zoom minus “100%” plus and fit-width icon. A genuine-looking illustrative textbook page on white paper sits in a lightly sage-tinted canvas, faint paper-edge shadow, mathematically typeset black print: page heading “2.3 贝叶斯公式”, two short readable paragraphs, the correct displayed equation P(A|B)=P(B|A)P(A)/P(B), equation number “(2.4)”, and a simple black-and-white probability tree using A and its complement, B and its complement. The page is clearly labelled tiny “自编教材页示意” in its margin to avoid implying it is an actual book scan. Preserve the original page's page number and margins. This must look like a source document page, not another AI summary.
RIGHT PANE: small pane heading “知识点解析”, a compact source chip “来源：第42–44页” with a link icon. Large beautiful serif title “从新证据，更新判断”. Elegant summary “贝叶斯公式把先验判断与新证据连接起来。” A displayed correct Bayesian formula on pale sage field, section “先理解：为什么要更新概率”, a short explanatory paragraph, a 3-step numbered explanation, a restrained worked-example callout labelled “帮助理解的自编示例” with no fabricated claim of being a textbook question, and a small “常见误区” section mentioning P(A|B) and P(B|A) differ. Bottom source chips link back to the left source page; one discreet “继续追问” control at edge. No fake external sources, authors, views, badges or recorded student effects.
Footer anchored at the very bottom of the main area: a full-width single quiet toolbar with a bordered “← 上一章 事件与概率” button on left, bookmark and “记笔记” center, a bordered “下一章 随机变量 →” button on right. No knowledge-point navigation card. No floating row of tiny “外部解析/朗读导出” buttons under the title. No duplicated main heading.
Make the whole screen balanced and ready for pixel-faithful native HTML/CSS implementation, with precise grid, legible labels and professional document comparison ergonomics.
